title: Rory and the Glowing Meadow
verses:
The stars started winking above in the sky,
As Rory walked slowly to rest near the stream.
High up in the canopy shadows flew by,
And Nia called down with a soft, silver gleam.

Psittaco hopped up on a stone by the ledge,
To point to a cavern that glowed in the dark.
And Ricky ran up to the mossy green edge,
To follow the trail of a faint, golden spark.

Inside was a meadow where blue mosses grew,
And Benny bent down as he leaned on the ground.
Then Tilly tucked in as the night breezes blew,
To listen to whispers that hummed all around.

The soft glow danced gently on floor and on wall,
While Psittaco settled inside a green fern.
A hush settled down on the cozy group all,
While stars in the sky started brightly to burn.

And Rory curled up on the carpet of moss,
And yawned as he rested his heavy green head.
The breeze blew a blanket of petals across,
To cover the friends in their magical bed.

Now Ricky was dreaming and Benny was still,
With Nia asleep in the shadows above.
The moon shed its light over valley and hill,
And wrapped all the world in a blanket of love.
